title: Restrict AI model providers (Anthropic, xAI) to approved users or groups
where: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > AI providers
reason: No API is documented; scoping is set in the admin center and needs a Global Administrator.

title: Limit who can create and share agents
where: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Settings, and Power Platform admin center > Settings > Copilot Studio authors
reason: No API is documented for agent sharing and creation settings.

title: Review the agent tools and MCP server registry
reason: No API is documented for the tools registry.

title: Apply Copilot Chat capability settings per group
reason: The Copilot policy settings API only sets tenant-wide values.

title: Set responsible AI protections per group
Decide on Copilot file upload
reason: File upload can only be changed through a Microsoft Support request.

title: Restrict users to the company ChatGPT or Claude workspace
where: Microsoft Entra admin center > Global Secure Access > custom headers
reason: Custom headers are in preview with no documented API, and need TLS inspection.

title: Define roles for models and features in ChatGPT and Claude
where: ChatGPT Enterprise Admin Console > Permissions & roles; Claude organization settings
reason: Roles are defined only in each vendor's console; membership can then follow groups.
